QueuedMessageWithdrawn.description: Content-free receipt for a held message withdrawn before it became a turn.
QueuedMessageWithdrawn.title: QueuedMessageWithdrawn

SystemCompactionStatus.description:
A compaction of the main conversation started or stopped.

Progress, not a record: ``started`` shows "Compacting context..." until
the ``system.compaction_boundary`` card (success) or a ``failed`` status
(with ``error``) replaces it; ``ended`` closes it without a verdict. The
turn's end clears it too, so a lost close can never leave it stuck.
SystemCompactionStatus.title: SystemCompactionStatus

usage.description: The turn's usage summary (tokens_in, tokens_out, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, total_cost_usd, duration_ms, num_turns). usage_estimated: true when any token count in this turn was estimated by the harness because the provider reported no usage or the reply was interrupted; absent otherwise.
usage.title: Usage

TurnProviderAlive.description:
The provider accepted this turn's model request and is still streaming.

Recorded from fluid's ``ProviderAlive``. It proves the request was accepted
and the response stream was open at that moment. It does not prove that
useful work continues. Liveness evidence for the Task worker's first-frame
watchdog (#1418), never content: clients ignore it. ``signal`` is fluid's
reason ("accepted", "reasoning", "keepalive").
TurnProviderAlive.title: TurnProviderAlive

usage.description: One model call's usage record (input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cost_usd, model_call_index). usage_estimated: true when a token count in this record was estimated by the harness (input_tokens_estimated / output_tokens_estimated name the guessed fields); absent otherwise.
usage.title: Usage
